reuse.why: Adds the closed-account rule to the existing shared pre-link guard that all six provider link functions already call.

duplication.why: The check is written once; no provider repeats it.

placement.why: It sits in the link-precondition function in accounts/app.ts beside the already-linked rule.

scope.why: Focused; the guard rename touches six call sites mechanically, plus a release note in the repo's usual format.

maintainability.why: A single, renamed precondition covering both link rules is easy to own.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All provider link handlers call assertBankAccountCanBeLinked.

one_place.where: assertBankAccountCanBeLinked in packages/loot-core/src/server/accounts/app.ts, called by the GoCardless, SimpleFIN, Pluggy, Akahu, Fintegra and EnableBanking link handlers.
